name: The Palantír of Orthanc
subtitle: Seventh Seeing-stone
game_text:
To play, spot an <culture>Isengard</culture> minion. Plays to your support area.
<phase>Shadow</phase>: Spot an <culture>Isengard</culture> minion and remove <twilight>2</twilight> to reveal the top card of any draw deck. You may place that card beneath that draw deck.
flavor_text: “‘The name meant that which looks far away.’”
